Inputs with zero denominator are excluded from the original function. \[N=x,\quad N^{\prime}=1\]\[D=x^{2} + 1,\quad D^{\prime}=2 x\]\[\frac{d}{dx}\frac ND=\frac{N^{\prime}D-ND^{\prime}}{D^2}=\frac{- x 2 x + 1 \left(x^{2} + 1\right)}{\left(x^{2} + 1\right)^{2}}\]
